## Type

- [ ] Task page (triage, capability tagging, media, notes)
- [ ] Taxonomy change (`data/taxonomy.yml`)
- [ ] Benchmark or backend registry

## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] Touches **one task page** — or is exempt (taxonomy, tooling, re-sync)
- [ ] I did not edit any `upstream:` block
- [ ] Any `drop` / `needs-review` has a falsifiable `status_reason`
- [ ] Judgement calls are signed with my handle
- [ ] No media files committed; media is referenced by URL
